name: blender_hosts
description: List the Blenders offered to OpenCode on this computer (Blender with the OpenCode Link add-on enabled): label, document, Blender version, which one is attached to this conversation (and, when only one is offered, whether another conversation uses it), with the add-on's install state. attach: attach one (its offerID) to this conversation, which asks permission; detach: release this conversation's Blender. With one offered Blender that no conversation uses, the first Blender tool call attaches it.
